## Summary

Describe the lesson, example, documentation, accessibility, or layout change.

## Change Type

- [ ] Lesson or documentation
- [ ] HTML structure
- [ ] CSS styling or responsive layout
- [ ] Accessibility improvement
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Maintenance

## Quality Checklist

- [ ] HTML uses meaningful semantic structure
- [ ] Heading order and landmarks remain logical
- [ ] Images have appropriate alternative text
- [ ] Forms have labels and understandable validation guidance
- [ ] Keyboard navigation and focus visibility were reviewed
- [ ] Mobile and desktop layouts were tested
- [ ] Links, paths, and assets work
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or confidential information are included
- [ ] Third-party content is legally reusable and properly attributed
- [ ] README, lesson index, or references were updated when required
- [ ] The contribution is compatible with the MIT License

## Evidence

Provide screenshots, browser details, validation results, or concise testing notes when relevant.
